These files are automatically updated by the build process. Please do not modify them.


21/10/2008 - Mark Hewitt
The above comment seems to be incorrect.  These files are not generated as a result of an ant build.  As far as I can see they are not generated as a result of any ant task.  I think the files were, at one time, generated by JBuilder EJB Designer by EDS and parachuted into the code base.

Ongoing maintenance of these files will have to be by hand, because we do not have JBuilder EJB Designer.
